preset_note: Chosen by the design lens at scene design (stage colour = complement of the hero's hue, composition gate), as in 006-011.
title: ¿Por qué tu cepillo de dientes no debe estar junto al inodoro? 🤢
curiosity_reason: Everyone has a toothbrush a metre from a toilet; the invisible spray is gross, hidden and testable tonight (look where your brush is).
hook_question: ¿Por qué no deberías tener tu cepillo de dientes cerca del inodoro?
false_belief: Al tirar la cadena, todo se va por el desagüe.
turn: Scene 6: bajar la tapa, the obvious fix, barely changed surface contamination in a 2024 study; cleaning the bowl did.
closing_reframe: Tu inodoro no solo se traga las cosas: también las estornuda.
share_archetype: esa persona que guarda su cepillo de dientes al lado del inodoro
engine_reason: code3d: rigid bathroom objects (toilet, toothbrush, cup) on the asset route; the droplets are a single rewritten mesh of beads, genuinely geometric, made visible by coloured water (reshape rung 2, the laser sheet read as foam).
description: Cada vez que tiras la cadena, el agua lanza al aire una nube de gotitas que no ves: en un experimento subió metro y medio en ocho segundos. Y bajar la tapa ayuda menos de lo que crees. 🤢 Envíaselo a esa persona que guarda su cepillo de dientes al lado del inodoro.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.narration: ¿Por qué no deberías tener tu cepillo de dientes cerca del inodoro? Crees que, al tirar la cadena, todo se va por el desagüe. No todo.
scenes.what_changes: A clean bathroom; the flush starts and a faint haze rises toward the toothbrush on the sink.
scenes.transformation: baño quieto, cepillo en su vaso junto al inodoro → se tira la cadena y una neblina tenue sube hacia el cepillo
scenes.camera: travelling lateral desde el cepillo hasta el inodoro, a la altura del lavamanos

scenes.name: descarga
scenes.narration: Al tirar la cadena, el agua entra con fuerza por el borde y choca contra lo que hay en la taza.
scenes.what_changes: Water bursts in from the rim and crashes into the bowl water: a calm pool becomes a turbulent swirl.
scenes.transformation: agua quieta en la taza → chorros desde el borde que chocan y la revuelven
scenes.camera: picado cenital que baja hacia el interior de la taza

elements.name: bowl water (turbulent)
elements.route: physically based water; draft profile for gate rounds, minimal transmission volume (render-time rule c)

scenes.name: nube
scenes.narration: Ese choque lanza al aire miles de gotitas. Si el agua tuviera color, las verías: en un inodoro público sin tapa, subieron metro y medio en ocho segundos.
scenes.what_changes: The bowl water turns blue, so the invisible droplets become visible: they erupt past the seat, climb to face height and speckle a white tile.
scenes.transformation: agua incolora en la taza → el agua se tiñe de azul y una columna de gotitas azules sube hasta manchar un azulejo blanco a la altura de la cara
scenes.camera: grúa ascendente que sigue la columna desde la taza hasta la altura de la cara
overlays_plan: counter 1,5 m at 'metro' (bracket alongside the plume)

elements.name: droplet plume in a laser sheet
elements.risk: medium: must read as spray, not smoke; aliases decided before reading

scenes.name: carga
scenes.narration: Las más finas siguen flotando en el aire. Y si en la taza había caca, viajan con sus bacterias.
scenes.what_changes: The plume stops rising and hangs; a fraction of the droplets turn yellow-green (biology colour), carrying what was in the bowl.
scenes.transformation: gotitas que suben → quedan suspendidas y una parte se tiñe de verde amarillento
scenes.camera: órbita lenta alrededor de la nube suspendida

elements.name: tinted droplets
elements.route: same particles, palette colour; microbes are NOT drawn

scenes.name: aterrizaje
scenes.narration: Después bajan y se posan: en el asiento, en el suelo y, si está cerca, en tu cepillo.
scenes.what_changes: The cloud drifts and settles: droplets land on the seat, the floor and finally the bristles of the toothbrush.
scenes.transformation: nube suspendida → gotitas que se posan una a una sobre el asiento, el suelo y las cerdas del cepillo
scenes.camera: seguimiento de una gotita desde la nube hasta un primer plano de las cerdas

scenes.name: giro
scenes.narration: ¿Y si bajas la tapa? En otro estudio, casi no cambió lo que quedaba en las superficies. Lo que funcionó fue desinfectar la taza. Y aleja el cepillo.
scenes.what_changes: The turn: the lid drops and the plume is squashed, but the seat and floor marks stay; then a brush scrubs the bowl clean and the toothbrush cup slides away.
scenes.transformation: tapa abierta → la tapa baja, las marcas siguen ahí → la taza se limpia y el vaso del cepillo se aleja
scenes.camera: plano medio frontal que se abre a plano general del baño
overlays_plan: mark (red X) on 'casi no cambió' near the closed lid

scenes.name: cierre
scenes.narration: Así que tu inodoro no solo se traga las cosas: también las estornuda. Envíaselo a esa persona que guarda su cepillo de dientes al lado del inodoro.
scenes.what_changes: Single reframe image: one last flush, the plume blooms like a sneeze from the open bowl; the camera pulls back to the whole bathroom.
scenes.transformation: inodoro quieto → una última descarga, la nube se abre como un estornudo
scenes.camera: retroceso amplio desde la taza hasta el baño completo
overlays_plan: ENVÍASELO tag (label, style tag) at_word 'envíaselo', ~2.6 s, in the free space beside the toilet

sources: Plume: Crimaldi et al. 2022, Scientific Reports, 'Commercial toilets emit energetic and rapidly spreading aerosol plumes' (University of Colorado Boulder): lidless commercial flushometer toilet, clean tap water, laser visualisation; particles reached about 1.5 m above the bowl within 8 s. Verified through secondary coverage (The Conversation / TechXplore 2022-12), original paper not opened. Narration states 'inodoro público sin tapa' because home tank toilets were NOT tested.

Lid: Goforth et al. 2024, American Journal of Infection Control, 'Impacts of lid closure during toilet flushing and of toilet bowl cleaning on viral contamination of surfaces in United States restrooms': surface contamination did not depend on lid position; disinfectant plus brush cleaning reduced bowl contamination by more than 99.99 %. Verified through news coverage (EurekAlert, HealthDay, 2024-01).

Droplets carry faecal bacteria: Gerba, Wallis, Melnick 1975, Applied Microbiology 30(2):229-237 (PMID 169732; abstract verified 2026-11-08): flushing produced droplets carrying seeded bacteria and viruses. No illness is claimed.
Toothbrush landing: an inference from the above (droplets settle on nearby surfaces), worded 'si está cerca'; no toothbrush study is cited on screen or in narration.
simplifications: The study toilet was a commercial flushometer without lid; the scene shows a home bathroom and the narration names the setting honestly.
Microbes are not drawn; the tint on droplets stands for what they carry.
flatness_test: 1. hook: A clean bathroom; the flush starts and a faint haze rises toward the toothbrush on the sink.
2. descarga: Water bursts in from the rim and crashes into the bowl water: a calm pool becomes a turbulent swirl.
3. nube: The bowl water turns blue, revealing the droplets: they erupt past the seat, climb to face height and speckle a white tile.
4. carga: The plume stops rising and hangs; a fraction of the droplets turn yellow-green (biology colour), carrying what was in the bowl.
5. aterrizaje: The cloud drifts and settles: droplets land on the seat, the floor and finally the bristles of the toothbrush.
6. giro: The turn: the lid drops and the plume is squashed, but the seat and floor marks stay; then a brush scrubs the bowl clean and the toothbrush cup slides away.
7. cierre: Single reframe image: one last flush, the plume blooms like a sneeze from the open bowl; the camera pulls back to the whole bathroom.

support_colours.reason: Teal tile wall derived from the Coral accent family: the white toilet must separate from it (a pale wall measured too close to white ceramic on paper).
